headline: A desktop launcher is proposed as OpenRAC updates its imported game code
summary: OpenRAC updates its imported decompilations and cross-project function map, while a desktop launcher proposal opens in #2. The proposed app would put disc setup, building, checks, PCSX2 and the level editor behind buttons, but the author calls it scaffolding and says most game actions have not yet been verified. Master receives source and documentation work rather than a release pull request, unlike its current release-only role.
highlights: The large line totals mostly come from imported game-source updates, not newly implemented launcher features.
Ratchet & Clank PAL's imported build now leaves compiler output unedited and applies compiler flags per file.
Going Commando's proposed source update #1 closes without merging. Its newer upstream work is brought over through a separate source sync.
